requested_outcome: Minimize the whole removable battery/MCU/display/frame stack from the case floor upward and deliver a case option hiding switches whose upper edge is level with the frame; allow the display to be flush.

requirements.outcome: Remove unjustified vertical support material and select the lowest evidenced complete stack, retaining both batteries and replaceable nice!nano v2/nice!view.
requirements.acceptance: Saved/reopened native candidate, dimensioned mating interfaces, both battery profiles and continuous cable/service checks; reject lower candidates with named constraints.

requirements.outcome: Provide a case variant that visually covers switch housings and shares the frame upper datum without moving the 36 key centers/angles.
requirements.acceptance: Closed printable solids, cap full-travel envelope clearance, preserved switch plate and service access, visual side/top acceptance.

requirements.outcome: Preserve editable CAD, matching PCB component references, frame/color options and supported KLP caps, printable exports and usable public configurator.

authority: Current explicit design request and existing Flan36 repository/public viewer publication scope; no purchasing or physical acceptance.

review.method: Two independent read-only reviews, constructive mechanics and adversarial reliability, followed by one focused second round on the dimensioned Samtec candidate.
review.consensus: Proceed with contained nominal CAD prototype; acceptance depends on geometry, continuous travel and service checks.

dispositions.finding: Commercial nice!view finished-hole diameter and toleranced .025-inch square-pin fit are unknown.
dispositions.disposition: Keep .9 mm hole as explicit unmeasured nominal; no drilling or hardware fit claim.

dispositions.finding: A 1.2 mm roof would intersect the PCB and solder at 13.39 mm.
dispositions.disposition: Local PCB undercut and open header service well; preserve .8 mm backing requirement where .4 mm inlays exist.

dispositions.finding: Stored battery leads must descend without disconnecting fixed PH terminals.
dispositions.disposition: Continuous radius-controlled 3D ramp; retain 105 mm length and verify terminal positions.

dispositions.finding: Display row was modeled 2.4 mm away from J2.
dispositions.disposition: Use official 1.3 mm end offset and common 50.8 mm row; add registration acceptance.

dispositions.finding: Raised shell can obstruct cap travel and service.
dispositions.disposition: Conservative union of all admitted cap variants and rotations over full3.5 mm travel; preserve removable switch plate and existing3 mounting screws.
